stanza: A glass of wine with you, sir
Is measured up by my own hand
It was my fate from birth
To make my mark upon the earth

dixon.line: Now you're a good surveyor, Dixon
dixon.lineNext: But I swear you'll make me mad
stanza: Now you're a good surveyor, Dixon
But I swear you'll make me mad
The West will kill us both
A Geordie and a baker's boy
In the forests of the Iroquois

nixon.line: Do you remember, your President Nixon?
nixon.lineNext: Do you remember, the bills you have to pay?
stanza: Do you remember, your President Nixon?
Do you remember, the bills you have to pay?
